text:
kevin: Heads-up — CloudSphere (partner) asked for a marketplace-ready Terraform module + quickstart that proves compatibility with our dedicated runtime. They want a minimal example that does: VPC, subnets, security groups, and an autoscaling pool for inference nodes. demo scheduled Mon 03/30.

maria: I can own the module skeleton. I'll start with registry-style inputs: region, instance_profile, subnet_ids, node_count, model_artifact_uri. Need partner requirements doc (networking + logging) from sales.

cloud-partner-rep: Thanks — we can share the partner checklist. Also need a short sample app that calls the Redwood API with region hints.

arun: I'll take CI + tests. Plan: GH Actions matrix for terraform 1.3/1.4, tflint, terraform fmt check, and a small smoke deploy using localstack or lightweight infra-runner. Also add acceptance test that verifies LB target group health and a successful inference call (mock).

linda: Ops asks that the template include explicit egress CIDR notes and an option to send logs to partner-managed S3. Also add IAM least-privilege for node role.

kevin: To keep this marketplace-friendly we need: 1) module + README with step-by-step quickstart, 2) published registry example, 3) automated smoke test on PR, and 4) a short architecture diagram. Who can own the diagram and docs?

maria: I'll draft README + examples. For the diagram, can we use the infra-diagrams kit? I can produce a simple PNG and an ASCII diagram for the README.

jamie: I'll take comms and announcement planning once engineering has a PR. Need a 2-paragraph partner blurb, bullets for supported regions, and a screenshot of the console + sample call.

kevin: Timeline proposal: module PR by Fri EOD, CI smoke green by next Tue, partner review Wed, docs + comms by Thu. Demo to partner on Mon 03/30. If anyone needs to slip, call it out now.

arun: Quick note on test infra — using real GPUs is heavy. I'll mock infer responses and validate networking + autoscale triggers. For integration tests later we can run a short real-run on our dedicated test pool (ask infra for a two-hour window).

cloud-partner-rep: We need the module to expose a toggle for using partner-managed image vs marketplace image. Also legal wants a short note about customer data residency.

linda: Adding a variable `use_partner_image` + `image_id` and doc blurb on residency. Also adding an outputs block with load_balancer_dns and node_instance_profile.

kevin: Example usage snippet (for README) — keep it tiny so comms can screenshot quickly:

```terraform
module "redwood_inference_pool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-modules/cloudsphere-module"
  region = "us-west-2"
  subnet_ids = ["subnet-abc", "subnet-def"]
  node_count = 2
  use_partner_image = false
}
```

maria: Nice. I'll include that and a one-liner for the sample app: `curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}'`

deploy-bot: Created issue #472 in partners/marketplace-onboarding: "cloudsphere terraform module + quickstart" (assignee: maria).

jamie: FYI I'll loop in marketing for the joint announcement cadence — we usually want a week for approvals. If engineering lands PR by Fri, marketing can prep a draft by Tue.

kevin: Ok, action items: maria = module + README + diagram; arun = CI + smoke tests; linda = security + outputs; jamie = comms + partner blurb; kevin = coordinate partner review + schedule demo.

maria: I'll open the skeleton repo tonight and link it here. Expect initial PR link by Thursday morning.

cloud-partner-rep: Thanks all — we'll prepare sample model artifact and a short test key. Ping me with any blockers.

kevin: Great. If anything blocks the Fri PR goal, flag it here or DM. :thumbsup:
